{{Top|notoc=1|canon=Water pistol}}
{{Otheruses|water}}
A '''water gun''' was a type of [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]]<ref name="Mutations">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Mutations|Taris}}</ref> in existence around [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Good. Because a blaster was about as effective as a water gun.|Larris Cozekk, regarding combating irradiated rakghouls|<ref name="Mutations" />}}
[[Water/Legends|Water]] guns were mentioned in the mission "Mutations" of the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was developed by [[BioWare]] and published jointly by [[LucasArts]] and [[Electronic Arts]]. In the mission, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic trooper|trooper]] [[Larris Cozekk]] compares the ineffectiveness of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] against [[Radiation/Legends|irradiated]] [[rakghoul]]s to that of water guns. The line of dialogue mentioning water guns only appears if the player selects the response "I can handle it" while controlling a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] character.<ref name="Mutations" /> In real life, a [[Wikipedia:Water gun|water gun]], or water pistol, is a [[Wikipedia:Toy gun|toy gun]] that shoots water.<ref name="Britannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/dictionary/water-pistol|text=Water pistol|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|Encyclopædia Britannica]]|archivedate=20240909173317}}</ref>

===Non-canon history===
{{Quote|I challenge my neighbors to a duel. Water Pistols at dawn!|A citizen through the HoloNet feed|<ref name="Star Wars: Tiny Death Star">''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]''</ref>}}
In the [[2013]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]'', water guns are identified as "'''Water Pistols'''," and referenced in [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] dialogue to be utilized in duels between feuding neighbors on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]].<ref name="Star Wars: Tiny Death Star" />
